items.title: 2.2.1.2 Variable Naming Rules in Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of naming rules (PDF 36).

blocks.text: Python mein variable ke naam in rules (qawaid) ke mutabiq hone chahiyein:

items: Naam kisi letter (a-z, A-Z) ya underscore ( _ ) se shuru ho.
Pehle character ke baad wale characters letters, digits (0-9) ya underscores ( _ ) ho sakte hain.
Naam case-sensitive hain, yani age aur Age do alag variables hain.
Python ke reserved keywords (Python ke apne khaas words), jaise for, while, if waghera, variable ka naam nahi ban sakte.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Variables ke naam hamesha meaningful (jin se matlab samajh aaye) rakhein ta ke code samajhna aasan ho. Maslan a ki bajaye age likhein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Sahi naam: age, student_name, _total, marks2. Ghalat naam: 2marks (digit se shuru), student-name (hyphen), student name (space), for (keyword).

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaunsa sahi variable naam hai: variable1, 1variable, variable-name, variable name (MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: variable1, option (a); baqi digit se shuru hote ya hyphen ya space rakhte hain.

blocks.text: Yeh program sahi naamon wale variables istemal karta hai. age aur Age do alag variables hain kyun ke Python case-sensitive (chhote aur bare letter ka farq rakhne wali) hai; dono ki values badal kar Run karein.

student_name = "Ali"
marks2 = 85
_total = 100
age = 17
Age = 40    # alag variable: chhota a aur bara A alag hain
print(student_name, "ke marks:", marks2, "out of", _total)
print("age =", age)
print("Age =", Age)

items: Naam letter ya _ se shuru; phir letters, digits, _.
Case-sensitive; keywords mana; meaningful naam rakhein.
